stories.title: This week's new music: Skee Mask, MJ Nebreda, Valentina Magaletti
stories.summary: RA rounds up ten new release announcements. They include Skee Mask's 'Peacemanagement' on Ilian Tape (out 26 November), 'Triptych 1' by Daisy Moon, Or:la and D. Tiffany on Off-Kilter (27 November), MJ Nebreda's 'Pussy Pop' on Giant Music and Valentina Magaletti's self-released 'RESPIRIA!' (30 November). Also listed: Asphalt DJ's 'Work Out' on Paryìa Records, Jorg Kuning's 'Clun Pearls' on Wisdom Teeth (5 February 2027) and Group Therapy's World AIDS Day '26 compilation (4 December).

stories.title: Listen to a 32-track Southern club music compilation
stories.summary: Club South has released 'Southern Hospitality', a various-artists compilation of 32 tracks by 15 artists including Big Ace, DJ Young Brown, GENO, IDKRYAN and King Virgo. All proceeds go to the mutual aid group Houston Food Not Bombs. Club South and the collectives Break N Enter, Club Shugga, For Keeps and Identity Trade are throwing a two-day release party at Boondocks in Houston this weekend.

stories.title: EVAWAVE estreia-se com I GOT U: "É um misto de tantas coisas, vou beber a tantos sítios"
stories.summary: Interview by Ricardo Farinha with Portuguese producer EVAWAVE (Eva Esteves, 39). Her debut EP 'I GOT U' came out on her birthday and is her first release on the independent collective and label Monster Jinx, which she joined about two years ago. She calls her sound a mix of hip hop and electronic music. She has moved from sampling to building tracks from scratch with synths, MIDI controllers and virtual instruments, and uses her voice as an instrument rather than for lyrics.

stories.title: This week's top stories: RIP Delano Smith, Jamaica Suk, Kenny 'Jammin' Jason
stories.summary: RA's weekly round-up leads with three deaths. Berlin techno DJ and Gradient founder Jamaica Suk died (reported 24 November), as did Detroit house artist Delano Smith (23 November) and Chicago house pioneer and Hot Mix 5 member Kenny 'Jammin' Jason (20 November). The round-up also covers a new Burial book announced on 23 November and Discótica's launch of a large library of Latin American electronic music on 25 November.
